Parameters.Name: ConfigPath
ConfigPath
Parameters.Description:
Path to the configuration file.

    .OUTPUTS
    PSCustomObject. The loaded configuration object.
    #>
    param(
        [string]$ConfigPath = "configs\system-config.json"
    )

    try {
        $fullPath = Get-ConfigPath -ConfigPath $ConfigPath

        if (-not (Test-Path $fullPath)) {
            Write-Warning "Configuration file not found: $fullPath"
            Write-Warning "Creating default configuration..."
            New-DefaultConfiguration -ConfigPath $ConfigPath
        }

        $jsonContent = Get-Content -Path $fullPath -Raw -Encoding UTF8
        $config = $jsonContent | ConvertFrom-Json

        # Validate configuration structure
        $isValid = Test-Configuration -Config $config
        if (-not $isValid) {
            Write-Warning "Configuration validation failed. Using default values."
            $config = Get-DefaultConfiguration
        }

        # Store in global variable
        $Global:DevOptimizerConfig = $config

        Write-Log "Configuration loaded successfully from: $fullPath" -Level "INFO" -Component "Config"
        return $config

    } catch {
        Write-Error "Failed to load configuration: $($_.Exception.Message)"
        Write-Log "Failed to load configuration: $($_.Exception.Message)" -Level "ERROR" -Component "Config"

        # Return default configuration as fallback
        $defaultConfig = Get-DefaultConfiguration
        $Global:DevOptimizerConfig = $defaultConfig
        return $defaultConfig
    }
}

function Get-Configuration {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
    Gets the current system configuration.

    .DESCRIPTION
    Returns the loaded configuration object. If not loaded, loads it first.

    .OUTPUTS
    PSCustomObject. The system configuration object.
    #>

    if ($Global:DevOptimizerConfig -eq $null) {
        Load-Configuration -ConfigPath "configs\system-config.json"
    }

    # Ensure we return a single object, not an array
    if ($Global:DevOptimizerConfig -is [array]) {
        Write-Log "Configuration loaded as array, taking first element" -Level "WARN" -Component "Config"
        return $Global:DevOptimizerConfig[0]
    }

    return $Global:DevOptimizerConfig
}

.\Repair-Devin.ps1
    Dry-run: shows what each repair would do right now. Changes nothing.
Scripts.Description:
Companion to Check-DevinHealth.ps1 (which detects problems and can repair a corrupt
    bundle). This script performs the individual repair actions with a dry-run default:
    with no switches it only prints what each repair WOULD do and changes nothing.

    Never touches: extensions/, data/, settings, the live commit dir, or .installation_lock.
    The rule from the field notes: check WSL health FIRST - stale .devin-server state is
    rarely the issue. The one exception is a corrupt bundle (ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND in
    server-main.js or extensionHostProcess.js), which -FixBundle handles.

Scripts.Name: Maintain-SocialAuto
Examples:
.\Maintain-SocialAuto.ps1
    Standard maintenance pass (safe actions on, unhealthy report-only).
Scripts.Description:
Performs only non-disruptive actions and reports on everything else:

    SAFE (default ON):
      - Prunes exited containers, dangling (untagged) images, and build cache
        older than 7 days. Never touches running containers, tagged images
        (rollback snapshots), volumes, or networks.
      - Drops WSL page caches when host free memory is below -MinHostFreeGB
        (proven safe; caches rebuild on demand).
    REPORT-ONLY (no action without -Remediate):
      - Unhealthy containers are listed; -Remediate restarts them (they are
        already failing, so this cannot take the platform down).
    INFORMATIONAL:
      - DMR health + loaded models, watchdog status, docker system df, and a
        reminder that all containers use unbounded json-file logs (fixing that
        requires container recreation - downtime - so it stays manual).

    Deliberately NOT automated (downtime-bearing): image updates, container
    recreates, vhdx compaction, wsl --shutdown, volume prune.
